sum_cpu.scope: Whole process, including input import and four generations; self user-cycle percentages

median_gpu_eval.scope: Only samples with run_cpu_backend_impl in captured callchain; inclusive percentages overlap

limitations: Sampling is user-cycle weighted, not wall-clock attribution. GPU wait and kernel execution are not measured by these percentages.
Whole-process sample includes initialization; reproduction subset depends on unwind coverage and cannot recover truncated callchains.
Initial 199Hz/8192-byte GPU-e recording was shallow; 999Hz/32768-byte recording improves coverage but does not eliminate unknown frames.
No new runtime optimization or speedup claimed.
next_experiments: CPU phase execution: precompute immutable binding layout and reduce interpreter frame/value movement while preserving lazy captures, isolation and fuel.

CPU/GPU-e reproduction: reduce repeated analysis/certification and content serialization inside existing native operators; preserve grammar membership, owner validity and CPU1T. GPU-er/o remain GPU reproduction.
